description: This file is a Perl script implementing optimized x86 assembly routines for GHASH operations used in cryptography, specifically for the OpenSSL project. It includes code paths for vanilla x86 and SSE, with detailed comments on performance and implementation techniques.

methods.name: clmul64x64_T2
methods.description: Performs 64x64 bit carry-less multiplication with minimal register pressure, used in GHASH implementation.

methods.name: clmul64x64_T3
methods.description: Alternative 64x64 bit carry-less multiplication routine with better ILP, used in GHASH implementation.

methods.name: reduction_alg9
methods.description: Performs polynomial reduction in GF(2^128) using Algorithm 9, optimized for performance.

methods.name: reduction_alg5
methods.description: Performs polynomial reduction in GF(2^128) using Algorithm 5, for reference and comparison.
